parameters.help_en:
The description of the traffic mirror filter.

The description must be 1 to 256 characters in length and cannot start with `http://` or `https://`
parameters.help_zh:
流量镜像筛选条件的描述信息。

描述长度为1～256个字符，不能以`http://`或`https://`开头
parameters.name: traffic_mirror_filter_description

parameters.help_en:
The name of the traffic mirror filter.

The name must be 1 to 128 characters in length and cannot start with `http://` or `https://`
parameters.help_zh:
流量镜像筛选条件的名称。

名称长度为1～128个字符，不能以`http://`或`https://`开头
parameters.name: traffic_mirror_filter_name

parameters.help_en:
The client token that is used to ensure the idempotence of the request.

You can use the client to generate the token, but you must make sure that the token is unique among different requests. The token can contain only ASCII characters.

If you do not specify this parameter, the system automatically uses the RequestId value as the ClientToken value. The RequestId value is different for each API request
parameters.help_zh:
客户端Token，用于保证请求的幂等性。

从您的客户端生成一个参数值，确保不同请求间该参数值唯一。ClientToken只支持ASCII字符。

若您未指定，则系统自动使用API请求的RequestId作为ClientToken标识。每次API请求的RequestId不一样
parameters.name: client_token

parameters.help_en:
Specifies whether to perform a dry run. Valid values:

true: performs a dry run. The system checks the required parameters, request format, and limits. If the request fails the dry run, an error message is returned. If the request passes the dry run, the `DryRunOperation` error code is returned.

false (default): sends a normal request. If the request passes the dry run, a 2xx HTTP status code is returned and the traffic mirror filter is created
parameters.help_zh:
是否只预检此次请求。取值：

true：发送检查请求，不会创建流量镜像筛选条件。检查项包括是否填写了必需参数、请求格式、业务限制。如果检查不通过，则返回对应错误。如果检查通过，则返回错误码`DryRunOperation`。

false（默认值）：发送正常请求，通过检查后返回2xx HTTP状态码并直接创建筛选条件
parameters.name: dry_run

fields.help_en:
The collection policy of the inbound rule. Valid values:

accept: collects network traffic.
drop: does not collect network traffic
fields.help_zh:
入方向规则的采集策略。取值：

accept：采集网络流量。
drop：不采集网络流量
fields.name: action

fields.help_en: The destination CIDR block of network traffic for the inbound rule
fields.help_zh: 入方向规则网络流量的目的地址网段
fields.name: destination_cidr_block

fields.help_en:
The destination port range of network traffic for the inbound rule. The port range is 1 to 65535. Separate the start port and end port with a forward slash (/). Example: 1/200 or 80/80.

If IngressRules.N.Protocol is set to ALL or ICMP, you do not need to set this parameter, which indicates that all ports are available
fields.help_zh:
入方向规则网络流量的目的端口范围。端口范围为1~65535，使用正斜线（/）隔开起始端口和终止端口，格式为1/200、80/80。

当IngressRules.N.Protocol取值为ALL或ICMP时，该参数无需设置，表示不限制端口
fields.name: destination_port_range

fields.help_en:
The IP version of the instance. Valid values:

IPv4: IPv4.
IPv6: IPv6
fields.help_zh:
实例的IP协议版本。取值：

IPv4：IPv4版本。
IPv6：IPv6版本
fields.name: ip_version

fields.help_en:
The priority of the inbound rule. A smaller value indicates a higher priority.
The maximum value of N is 10, which indicates that you can configure up to 10 inbound rules for a traffic mirror filter
fields.help_zh:
入方向规则的优先级。数字越小，优先级越高。
其中N最大取值为10，即一个筛选条件最多可配置10条入方向规则
fields.name: priority

fields.help_en:
The protocol type of network traffic to be mirrored for the inbound rule. Valid values:

ALL: all protocols.
ICMP: Internet Control Message Protocol.
TCP: Transmission Control Protocol.
UDP: User Datagram Protocol
fields.help_zh:
入方向需要镜像的网络流量使用的协议类型。取值：

ALL：所有协议。
ICMP：网络控制报文协议。
TCP：传输控制协议。
UDP：用户数据报协议
fields.name: protocol

fields.help_en: The source CIDR block of network traffic for the inbound rule
fields.help_zh: 入方向规则网络流量的源地址网段
fields.name: source_cidr_block

fields.help_en:
The source port range of network traffic for the inbound rule. The port range is 1 to 65535. Separate the start port and end port with a forward slash (/). Example: 1/200 or 80/80.

If IngressRules.N.Protocol is set to ALL or ICMP, you do not need to set this parameter, which indicates that all ports are available
fields.help_zh:
入方向规则网络流量的源端口范围。端口范围为1~65535，使用正斜线（/）隔开起始端口和终止端口，格式为1/200、80/80。

当IngressRules.N.Protocol取值为ALL或ICMP时，该参数无需配置，表示不限制端口
fields.name: source_port_range

fields.help_en:
The collection policy of the outbound rule. Valid values:

accept: collects network traffic.
drop: does not collect network traffic
fields.help_zh:
出方向规则的采集策略。取值：

accept：采集网络流量。
drop：不采集网络流量
fields.name: action

fields.help_en: The destination CIDR block of network traffic for the outbound rule
fields.help_zh: 出方向规则网络流量的目的地址网段
fields.name: destination_cidr_block

fields.help_en:
The destination port range of network traffic for the outbound rule. The port range is 1 to 65535. Separate the start port and end port with a forward slash (/). Example: 1/200 or 80/80. The value -1/-1 cannot be set independently and indicates that all ports are available.

If EgressRules.N.Protocol is set to ALL or ICMP, you do not need to set this parameter, which indicates that all ports are available
fields.help_zh:
出方向规则网络流量的目的端口范围。端口范围为1~65535，使用正斜线（/）隔开起始端口和终止端口，格式为1/200、80/80，其中-1/-1不能单独设置，代表不限制端口。

fields.help_en:
The IP version of the instance. Valid values:

IPv6: IPv6
fields.help_zh:
实例的IP协议版本。取值：

IPv4： IPv4版本。
IPv6： IPv6版本
fields.name: ip_version

fields.help_en:
The priority of the outbound rule. A smaller value indicates a higher priority.
The maximum value of N is 10, which indicates that you can configure up to 10 outbound rules for a traffic mirror filter
fields.help_zh:
出方向规则的优先级。数字越小，优先级越高。
其中N最大取值为10，即一个筛选条件最多可配置10条出方向规则
fields.name: priority

fields.help_en:
The protocol type of network traffic to be mirrored for the outbound rule. Valid values:

ALL: all protocols.
ICMP: Internet Control Message Protocol.
TCP: Transmission Control Protocol.
UDP: User Datagram Protocol
fields.help_zh:
出方向需要镜像的网络流量使用的协议类型。取值：

ALL：所有协议。
ICMP：网络控制报文协议。
TCP：传输控制协议。
UDP：用户数据报协议

fields.help_en: The source CIDR block of network traffic for the outbound rule
fields.help_zh: 出方向规则网络流量的源地址网段
fields.name: source_cidr_block

fields.help_en:
The source port range of network traffic for the outbound rule. The port range is 1 to 65535. Separate the start port and end port with a forward slash (/). Example: 1/200 or 80/80. The value -1/-1 cannot be set independently and indicates that all ports are available.

If EgressRules.N.Protocol is set to ALL or ICMP, you do not need to set this parameter, which indicates that all ports are available
fields.help_zh:
出方向规则网络流量的源端口范围。端口范围为1~65535，使用正斜线（/）隔开起始端口和终止端口，格式为1/200、80/80，其中-1/-1不能单独设置，代表不限制端口。

The tag key can be up to 128 characters in length and cannot start with `aliyun` or `acs:`. It cannot contain `http://` or `https://`

资源的标签键。最多支持输入20个标签键。如需传入该值，则不能输入空字符串。

一个标签键最多支持128个字符，不能以`aliyun`和`acs:`开头，不能包含`http://`或者`https://`
